programs.title: Baylen Out Loud
programs.sub_title: Your Anxiety Is Giving Me Anxiety
programs.desc: While meeting with their wedding planners, Baylen and Colin are dealt another blow to their wedding budget. The Duprees are off to London for a potential life-changing experience as Baylen will get to try a device that could reduce her tics. However, Baylen's difficulty navigating the airport and Colin's severe flight anxiety threatens to derail the journey before it begins.

programs.title: Baylen Out Loud
programs.desc: The Duprees arrive in London! And they must quickly navigate the culture shock; on a double-decker tour bus, Baylen becomes overstimulated, and her tics escalate, causing her a lot of distress.

programs.title: Baylen Out Loud
programs.desc: Baylen and Colin take on Washington D.C. and taste some of the city's best cuisines in hope of expanding their palates and finding inspiration for what to serve on their wedding day.

programs.title: Baylen Out Loud
programs.desc: Baylen and Colin are ready to say "I do," but their slow approach to wedding planning has everyone on edge; Baylen and family travel to London in the hopes of finding Baylen long-term relief from her Tourette's.

programs.title: Baylen Out Loud
programs.desc: With less than seven months to their big day, Baylen and Colin are still struggling to make major wedding decisions; Baylen and maid of honor Sammi are at odds over the planning of Baylen and Colin's joint bachelor and bachelorette weekend.
